# sspi_platform (Data Source)

Fetches details of an SSP Platform instance in SSPI.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the platform.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the vSphere cluster.
- `datastore` (String) The name of the vSphere datastore.
- `domain` (String) The domain name for the platform instance.
- `status` (String) The status of the platform deployment.
